en: I guess I shoulda expected that from the guy to best my buddy.

...Uhrr...

SOLARIS: Hmm...

Hey, guys...
I think I need to sleep for a little bit...

I'm just really...

Nevertheless, farewell.

OTS, we'll win this fight! Everything will be all right!
JULIA: S-U-C-C-E-S-S!

AMARIA: Huh? What happened here...?
AMARIA: Oh, well, it's very nice to meet you, \PN!  And welcome to our home!
FLORINIA: They have.

Of course I know who you are!
FLORINIA: The Obsidia Ward crisis was resolved with your aid some time ago.
JULIA: That was when you met \PN, right?

I do have a splitting headache if that means anything?

Anyway, I'm gonna wait here until Amy feels better, so do you wanna check on Tania?

JULIA: Zzz...

LOGIC!

Try Electric attacks!

She's not doing too hot, but her Scald TM more than makes up for that.
Gottem~

Anyway, she probably won't come up on her own.
If you wanna battle her, you'll have to drag her out from under there yourself!

Isolating herself and moping is like her version of my blowing things up!
It helps us feel better, but we probably shouldn't be allowed to do it anyway.
So go catch her already!

Everything is falling back into this plastic facade and if I try to break it, her blood will be on my hands.

Princess in a tower.

Phenomenal, absolutely phenomenal...
That was an incredibly fun battle.

I'll fly us there!

And the look on Taka's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
...But even the best days can't last forever.
I know you need to head back to your own time.
I'm sure you could spend forever in Agate, talking to everyone and seeing what they're doing now.
SHELLY: ...But don't you think that's a story for another time?
SHELLY: Oh, and \PN?

Celebi is clapping after watching two Champions battle!
CHAMPION: So, you've finally returned.
Welcome back, Taka and \PN.
Welcome back, Elias and \PN.
CHAMPION: Do you like what I've done with the place?
I took some cues from my old Gym.
CHAMPION: At first, people were at a loss of what to do without you.
But sometimes people need to take charge of their own destiny.
CHAMPION: And it all turned out pretty well.
Reborn is thriving.
We've established connections with many other regions, and have grown into a global center for research and battle.
CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean you weren't missed.
I may not have always shown it, but I enjoyed the time I spent with both of you.
CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean your absence wasn't felt.
Reborn lost two of its best trainers when you vanished.
CHAMPION: There I go, getting sentimental.
Over the last ten years, I've learned to open up to all of my wonderful friends.
And I'm glad to see two more are back in my life.
CHAMPION: But of course, you're more than just trainers.
You're people that have been missed.
I wasn't always the best at expressing my emotions in the past, but...
I'm very happy to see you again, \PN.

So, what do you think? Too much?
I mean, I love being surrounded by trees, and Tania got me really into fairytales these last ten years...
So it seemed just right!
TAKA: Wait, Shelly?
You're...
Not exactly who I expected.
But uh... Hey yourself.
I like it; this place looks nice.
SHELLY: I'm glad you like it!
So, let's compare notes real quick.
You found Celebi, presumably injured in the creation of the New World.
You attempted to nurse it back to health, but realized its injuries were too complex for normal medicine.
And then you proceeded to jump through time with Celebi, trying to find a solution.
And now you're here, no doubt because Celebi was drawn by the Relic Stone?
How'd I do, miss anything?
TAKA: That's... pretty spot on, actually.
How'd you know all that?
SHELLY: Well, even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
Between improving infrastructure and making connections with other regions...
I've been studying!
Legendary Pokémon, in particular. Including Celebi.
And I just tried to predict how Celebi would behave.
TAKA: That's... really cool.
So you're like, Reborn's Champion AND Professor?
SHELLY: Gosh, you flatter me!
But no, I'm not a Professor.
I won't have the official qualification until the end of the year.
But enough about me, come over here!
You'll want to see this!
SHELLY: Ta~daa!
One Relic Stone, straight from the New World,
And one happy healthy Celebi, fully recovered!
However, before you can all go back to your time, I'm afraid there is one slight problem with all this.
TAKA: Oh no... Did we mess up the timeline somehow?
SHELLY: Don't be silly!
You've done a great job, I'm sure.
No, the problem is simple.
I never got to fight the previous Champion when I claimed my title.
Of course, we've battled before, and I lost.
But I'm a whole different trainer now.
So let's see how that battle would've gone.
Let me know when you're ready!
TAKA: Y'know, I'm kind of glad I'm not you.
At least everyone isn't desperate to battle me.
Uh, good luck!

Thank heavens it's you and not...
I was concerned I was about to get stabbed.
SHELLY: I mean, I AM still pretty steamed you used your nepotism powers to get the OTHER awkward Bug Type Trainer an Elite Four spot instead of me.

SHELLY: Kidding!
ELIAS: That was very impressive...
I do believe you have covered everything.
SHELLY: I'm happy to hear it.
Even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
ELIAS: I clearly underestimated you, Shelly.
I had believed that without my Lord's guidance, surely the region would fall into disarray once more.
...Father Taube had faith in the people of Reborn.
I clearly have yet to learn all I need to from him.
SHELLY: Taube, you say?
Gosh, did you meet him while traveling through time?
How exciting! I would have loved the opportunity to learn from him.
Forgive me, but how do you know who Taube is?
SHELLY: As I mentioned, I spent a lot of time researching Legendary Pokémon.
Taube Alcantara is probably one of the foremost scholars of Legendary Pokémon to have ever lived!
It took a lot of work to find his writings, but they were a treasure trove of knowledge once I did!
And not just for my research, either; there were manuscripts detailing previously unknown history of Reborn, as well as details of lost traditions.
Finding something like that...
Well, as Champion, I had a responsibility to research further.
I've been doing my best to help the region reconnect with its history.
ELIAS: That's...
SHELLY: Oh, but there I go again, on and on about my research.
Follow me; you'll both want to see this!
ELIAS: This future is... wonderful.
The Alcantara family line has ended, and I am solely responsible.
That is a burden I will never stop carrying.
And yet... the future is bright.
The Order's teachings live on.
The Champion of Reborn is teaching the people to remember and respect the old ways...
Thank you for showing me this, my Lord.
Truly; it means...
ELIAS: Such an accomplished Champion...
But you're missing one key accomplishment.
SHELLY: Exactly.
ELIAS: My Lord smiles on me today.
For I suspect I am about to witness the greatest battle this region has ever seen.
TAKA: Even without you, things have turned out pretty great...
I guess Reborn really is filled with great people.
ELIAS: ...When we get back, I'm going to get in touch with the Fairy Leader.
I need to apologize for manipulating xem under the Grand Stairway.
And... maybe there's value in talking to somebody else who remembers the old days of the region...
TAKA: Nearly home now.
I wonder who'll be in Agate City?
I wonder if they missed me...
No, sorry,
Taube wouldn't like me talking like that.
Neither would anyone we've met today, really.
So, um...
I hope they didn't miss us too much.
ELIAS: 10 years is a rather long time.
I hope long enough that those with a frostier opinion of me have had time to... thaw.
I don't wish for hostility towards me to dampen your enjoyment of the experience-- no matter how well earned that hostility may be.
Hm... "A Brief Review of Energy". Does that sound interesting?
"Energy exists in many forms, but it is seldom adequately appreciated.
One form of energy that is often neglected is that that exists not as power or potential, but the very spirit of being.
When you form a fist and strike, you are transferring energy.
The energy transfers through your body.
If you strike a target, it transfers into the target, damaging it.
This is commonly understood.
But consider the transfer of energy if you do not strike a target. What happens to it?
In answer, the energy still transfers even if no target is struck.
The very action of punching itself carries a force which is understood universally.
Even if you do not punch someone so much as punch at them, some part of them will still feel the impact of the punch's energy.
It may not manifest as physical pain or damage, but the energy will continue to flow, as always it does."
Okay, I need to get better at this: "How to Meditate".
Do you wanna be my study buddy?
"Meditation is simply the art of clearing your head of thoughts.
Although this sounds simple, it can be very difficult for the unpracticed.
To begin, play calming music, or find a quiet place, or place with some other natural rhythm (for instance, the rhythm of waves dancing on the beach).
Find a comfortable seated position, and close your eyes.
Then simply think about nothing.
When you first try this, you will quickly realize how difficult it is for you to stop thinking.
Thoughts will drift in and out despite your efforts.  This is normal.
But each time you find yourself thinking again, force yourself to return to a blank slate.
For beginners, it is also sometimes helpful to instead think only about the rhythm of one's breath.
Continue in this way to practice clearing your head and keeping it free of distraction for as long as you wish to meditate."
There's a guy who's come here recently.
